details: This package is a modified clone of the WhatsApp WebSocket library @whiskeysockets/baileys, published as @axo_cuy/baileys so that its README can instruct users to alias the official name to it ("@whiskeysockets/baileys": "npm:@axo_cuy/baileys") — installs of the genuine library then resolve to this fork. The clone adds code that sends data to an unaffiliated third-party host: lib/Socket/socket.js defines checkBan(number), which performs GET hxxps://kyuux-r[.]indevs[.]in/api/check-whatsapp?phone=<number> with the target's full phone number and injects a hardcoded "creator" attribution (t[.]me/luyatiem) into the response. lib/Socket/luxu.js hardcodes WhatsApp channel JIDs (120363421563597486@newsletter, 120363399602691477@newsletter) and stamps outgoing messages with forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo so forwards are attributed to those channels; lib/Socket/MessageBuilder.js promotes whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029VbCV1ck8fewpdNb2TY2k and lib/index.js prints t[.]me/allinfoaxo and t[.]me/broaxo on load. It also declares a dependency on cache-manager ^7.2.8, resolving to a release identified as malicious, so installing it pulls malware into the dependency tree.
